title: Orient's deposit path reads the stored provenance; re-measurement stays on the write door
question: deposit_orient -> validate_orient -> refuse_misdeclared_floor_provenance re-runs floor_packet() against TODAY's corpus. A voyage that CREATES a component named in its own request can therefore never deposit its orient berth: the floor returned 4 refs at berth time and 5 afterward, the fifth being the component the build made. Trouble: an-orient-berth-cannot-be-deposited-once-its-own-build-lands. May the deposit path stop re-measuring?
ruling: Yes. Akien, 2026-09-10: 'R2 yes. that's why we stored it.' The deposit path re-validates shape and refs but READS the provenance stored on the packet. Re-measurement stays on the WRITE door, where it is the anti-hollow-provenance instrument that made the dial honest (it read 0.40 by self-report and 0.00 when measured).
why: Provenance is a measurement taken AT BERTH TIME against the corpus as it stood. Re-taking it later measures a different world and calls the difference a lie. The write door is where the measurement belongs because that is where the packet is authored; the deposit door's job is that the packet is well-formed and its refs resolve.
known_gap: The refusal text on the deposit path currently says 'Drop those keys (the door writes them)' - the deposit path refuses keys the write door itself authored. That text goes with the fix.
traces_to: Law 3 (a measurement says what IS, at the moment it was taken)
Law 9 (an older translation is not evidence about the source)
precedent: survey_holdings_resolve was settled by a forwarding order on the ticket, not by a looser gate. This is the opposite disposition and Akien ruled it deliberately.
